epics.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Cycle Findings
epics.jtbd: When a self-falsification audit identifies unresolved findings, I want the root causes to be fixed directly, so that the container starts and the CI pipeline passes without inventing adjacent scope.
requirements: R1: The coverage audit pipeline stage must correctly verify underlying client brief requirements for department and course-based access control, without faking zero gaps, and address CI test failures on 401s.

R2: AuthController.performMoodleRoleSync must throw a concurrency exception (e.g., OptimisticLockingFailureException) when userService.updateRoleAtomically returns 0, instead of falling back to an unguarded update.
R3: JwtTokenProvider.extractJsonValue must explicitly fail when a key is not found or when JSON parsing fails, rather than swallowing exceptions and returning an empty string.
R4: AuthController.performMoodleRoleSync must invoke an external Moodle OAuth2/OIDC/LTI endpoint to sync roles, instead of solely reading from the local 'users' table.

slices.title: Resolve Backend Self-Falsification Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to address the stub and layer violations in AuthController, JwtTokenProvider, and the audit pipeline, so that the pipeline passes honestly without masked errors or fake integrations.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the coverage audit pipeline stage, When it executes, Then it accurately reports gaps for missing access control requirements and passes only if implemented without faking success.
Given AuthController.performMoodleRoleSync executing concurrently, When userService.updateRoleAtomically returns 0, Then an OptimisticLockingFailureException is thrown and the fallback unguarded update is not called.
Given JwtTokenProvider parsing a token, When a key is missing or the JSON is malformed, Then it explicitly fails or throws an exception rather than returning an empty string.
Given a request to sync Moodle roles, When AuthController.performMoodleRoleSync is invoked, Then it queries the external Moodle endpoint and processes the result instead of just reading local tables.
Given the fixes are implemented, When the test suite is run, Then the fixes are covered by tests ensuring regressions do not occur.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Code Quality and Test Pass Rate
